Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 9
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical data misattribution error in the final step. While the WebSurfer correctly gathered that Thomas N. Heffron died in 1951 and Victor Schertzinger died in 1941, the Planner incorrectly swapped these dates in its analysis. The Planner stated "Heffron (1941-10-26); Schertzinger (1951-05-24)", attributing Schertzinger's actual death date (1941) to Heffron and Heffron's actual death date (1951) to Schertzinger. This led to the incorrect conclusion that Heffron died earlier, when in reality, Schertzinger (1941) died earlier than Heffron (1951).
